visualCharacteristics: White cards with thin grey border and soft shadow; optional image on top (product shot on black), linked bold title (optional arrow), small description, optional blue chevron CTA; 2/3/4-up grid by item count.
contentPattern: One row per card; empty image cell kept for text-only cards.

structure.note: One row per card; empty image cell kept for text-only cards.

usage: Grid of white bordered cards with optional top image, linked title, short description and optional CTA link. Grid adapts 2/3/4-up from card count.
reuseGuidance: Use for resource/tool listings. Leave the image cell empty for text-only cards. Use plain cards for unbordered image tiles.
